content.title: TNC Q3 Deep Dive: Tariff Uncertainty and Industrial Softness Offset Product Gains
content.summary: Industrial cleaning equipment manufacturer Tennant Company fell short of the markets revenue expectations in Q3 CY2025, with sales falling 4% year on year to $303.3 million. On the other hand, the company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ estimates with revenue guided to $1.23 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.46 per share was 2.9% below analysts’ consensus estimates.

content.title: Tennant (TNC): Margin Decline Challenges Bullish Growth Narrative Despite Strong Earnings Outlook
content.summary: Tennant (TNC) saw earnings grow by 12.9% per year over the past five years, but its net profit margin has slipped to 4.4%, down from 8.5% last year. Revenue is forecast to increase at 5.5% per year, lagging behind the broader US market's 10.5% yearly growth projection. Tennant’s earnings are expected to surge 23% per year, outpacing the US market’s 16% rate.
